options.name: api_timeout
options.description: HTTP timeout to Scaleway API in seconds.

options.name: api_token
options.description: Scaleway OAuth token. This is required if O(profile) is not specified.

options.name: database_name
options.description: Name used to identify the database. Required for V(present) and V(restored) states. Ignored when O(state=absent) or O(state=exported).

options.name: expires_at
options.description: Expiration datetime of the database backup (ISO 8601 format). Ignored when O(state=absent), O(state=exported) or O(state=restored).

options.name: id
options.description: UUID used to identify the database backup. Required for V(absent), V(exported) and V(restored) states.

options.name: instance_id
options.description: UUID of the instance associated to the database backup. Required for V(present) and V(restored) states. Ignored when O(state=absent) or O(state=exported).

options.name: name
options.description: Name used to identify the database backup. Required for V(present) state. Ignored when O(state=absent), O(state=exported) or O(state=restored).

options.name: profile
options.description: The config profile in config file to load the Scaleway OAuth token from, use instead of O(api_token). It is also possible to set E(SCW_PROFILE) to use a SCW CLI config profile.

options.name: query_parameters
options.description: List of parameters passed to the query string.

options.name: region
options.description: Scaleway region to use (for example V(fr-par)).

options.name: state
options.description: Indicate desired state of the database backup. V(present) creates a backup. V(absent) deletes the backup. V(exported) creates a download link for the backup. V(restored) restores the backup to a new database.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Validate SSL certs of the Scaleway API.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for the instance to reach its desired state before returning.

options.name: wait_sleep_time
options.description: Time to wait before every attempt to check the state of the backup.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Time to wait for the backup to reach the expected state.
